about: The built-in marks and their variants against capabilities.json: each row's cells works, refused, or na (see capabilities.json), proved by the contract test `<row>.<capability>`, or unproved: declared to work, with no test proving it yet, which a proof makes works. inventory names the row on each surface (null where a surface has none, with the reason in absent); unlisted names what each surface offers that is not a mark, so that a new mark cannot go undeclared. Each row's chart is test/contracts/fixtures/rows.json's entry of its name.
